votes.motion: A motion was made by Monica Zoltanski, seconded by Zach Robinson to approve the Consent Calendar
A motion was made by Cyndi Sharkey, seconded by Marci Houseman, to accept the results of the 2021 election, pending the recount

A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Marci Houseman, to adopt Resolution #21-43C, a resolution appointing Mr. Donald Y. Milne as a representative from Sandy City to the Board of Trustees of the Metropolitan Water District of Salt Lake and Sandy
A motion was made by Marci Houseman, seconded by Zach Robinson, to approve Resolution #21-40c, accepting and authorizing submittal of the annual Sandy City Moderate Income Housing Report for 2021
A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Cyndi Sharkey, to table this item
A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Brooke Christensen, to adopt Resolution 21-44c, a resolution approving and adopting the 2021 Sandy City Water Conservation Plan

A motion was made by Cyndi Sharkey, seconded by Zach Robinson, to adopt Ordinance 21-29, an ordinance amending the Sandy City Code Title 7, "Purchasing Procedures," Chapter 7-1, "Purchasing" and replacing Chapter 7-2, "Lost, Abandoned or Unclaimed Property;" also providing a saving clause and effective date for the ordinance

A motion was made by Kris Nicholl, seconded by Zach Robinson, to Approve Resolution No. 21-41C. A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF SANDY CITY, SALT LAKE COUNTY, UTAH (THE "CITY"), AUTHORIZING THE EXECUTION OF A LOAN AGREEMENT BY AND BETWEEN THE STATE OF UTAH (acting through the Utah Department of Transportation - State Infrastructure Bank) AND THE CITY; SAID LOAN TO BE AUTHORIZED IN AN AGGREGATE AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED FIFTEEN MILLION DOLLARS ($15,000,000), WITH THE MAXIMUM TERM OF THE LOAN NOT TO EXCEED 15 YEARS, THE MAXIMUM INTEREST RATE NOT TO EXCEED 4% WHICH MAY BE PAID ON THE LOAN; DELEGATI
A motion was made by Marci Houseman, seconded by Zach Robinson to recess the City Council meeting and convene a meeting of the Redevelopment Agency Board of Sandy City
A motion was made by Alison Stroud, seconded by Zach Robinson to reconvene the City Council meeting
